name: Jonathan Warrey
committees: Legislative Management Artificial Intelligence and Data Center Committee (chairman)
stance: Chairs an interim study that includes federal preemption and a possible statutory ban on AI showing signs of exceeding human control.

statements.text: Prime sponsor of HB 1167 requiring AI disclosure statements on political content, signed by the governor.
Chairs the interim AI committee whose assignment includes reviewing federal preemption attempts and considering a statutory prohibition of AI designed to or showing signs of exceeding human control.
